issues: Turkish diacritics (ç/ğ/ı/İ/ö/ş/ü) render without accents in the rendered font — text says 'Urunler', 'Otomasyon', 'Islem Loglari', 'Yonetimi', 'Kullanici Adi', 'Sifre', 'Giris Yap' instead of the proper Turkish 'Ürünler / İşlem Logları / Yönetimi / Kullanıcı Adı / Şifre / Giriş Yap'. Source strings ARE present with correct Turkish chars in the DOM, but the loaded webfont appears to not include Turkish glyphs and falls back. Recommend loading a font that covers Latin Extended-A (e.g. Inter with tr subset, or set font-display and preload the tr subset).
